audience: customer success teams that run NPS and CSAT surveys with Retently

useCases.title: Check a score and its trend
useCases.text: Get the latest score of one metric with its rating distribution and response count. Then read the trends of a trend group for a period such as the past week.

useCases.title: Read the latest feedback from customers
useCases.text: List feedback filtered by date range and customer properties. Open one response to read its score, comment and tags.

useCases.title: Review campaigns and their templates
useCases.text: List the campaigns with their metric type and status. Then open a template to read its survey questions.

useCases.title: Add a customer and suppress an address
useCases.text: Create or update customers with their properties. Then add an e-mail address to the suppression list, so it gets no surveys.

useCases.title: Send a survey to customers who gave permission
useCases.text: Queue a survey through a campaign for up to 100 customers. Confirm the list first, because the survey emails real people. Use it only for customers who gave permission.
